changelog:
- Initial release: Introduces a specialized AI agent for Chief Creative Officer (CCO) tasks.
- Implements a structured, document-centric brainstorming workflow with iterative task decomposition and team collaboration.
- Requires all creative process steps and AI interactions to be documented in a central meeting minute wiki.
- Supports competitive “horse racing” ideation by assigning tasks to multiple AI models and synthesizing results.
- Integrates essential tools for meeting minute/report creation, AI model orchestration, and context preservation.
- Final deliverables include a detailed creative proposal and comprehensive meeting minutes as attachments.
summary: AI agent for chief creative officer tasks
